limitations.message: Parameter initialization, invocation, event dispatch and caller/callee control flow are outside this graph.
Non-literal expression evaluation may throw; possible exceptional edges do not establish an actual exception.
Await locations are recorded; external completion order, scheduling and side effects are not inferred.
Static relationships do not establish execution order, invocation count, or reachability at runtime.
Explicit supported DOM bindings may be extracted, but event dispatch, component prop forwarding, and handler execution are not established.
The outer graph does not encode branch choices. Optional function-body CFG details are structural, not runtime traces.
DB operations, schemas, and transactions are not semantically identified.
Return values and response/data flow are not extracted.
No commit SHA is available; locations refer only to this supplied analysis snapshot.
